game.title: Pokémon Scarlet
game.notes: Genesis Mode. Nintendo Switch has no native achievement/trophy system, and Scarlet has never released on any other platform. Scope decisions made at the research checkpoint: (1) The Hidden Treasure of Area Zero DLC gets two separate trophy lists under `dlc` — The Teal Mask and The Indigo Disk — per Rule 14, matching the precedent from Hyrule Warriors, Breath of the Wild, and Pokémon Legends Z-A earlier in this project; neither affects the base Platinum. (2) The base-game Paldea Pokédex's exact catchable total is disputed across sources (400 vs. 373) and whether the game displays an explicit completion percentage could not be confirmed, so PKS-025's trophy text avoids citing a specific number — verification instead uses the Shiny Charm, a discrete, unambiguous reward item only granted on full Pokédex registration, sidestepping the uncertainty entirely. (3) Mystery Gift-based Pokémon and expired real-world-time-limited Tera Raid event bosses (e.g. past 7-star event distributions) are excluded entirely from this list, not merely missable-flagged — these were time-gated promotional content spanning 2022-2024 that is almost certainly closed by now, and building a trophy around content a current player likely cannot access at all would violate Rule 13's 'reasonably achievable' standard even more directly than an online-only trophy would. (4) The Union Circle-gated Finizen-to-Palafin evolution (requires another player connected) is deliberately NOT used in any trophy per Rule 13, since it's the one Pokédex-relevant mechanic in the base game dependent on multiplayer and cannot be guaranteed available to a future solo player. (5) Team Star's five bosses are correctly NOT treated as Scarlet-exclusive (they're identical in both versions bar cosmetics) — only Great Tusk (replacing Violet's Iron Treads) as the Quaking Earth Titan is a genuine version-exclusive mandatory boss. (6) A note for the record: the original research brief referenced a character named 'Clive' — no such character exists in this game; the AI professor is Sada (Scarlet) / Turo (Violet). No trophy references this name.

trophies.name: Treasure Hunt
trophies.description: Begin your journey at Naranja Academy, receiving your starter Pokémon and the Tera Orb.
trophies.verification: The opening story sequence concludes with Director Clavell issuing the Treasure Hunt assignment, unlocking the open world.

trophies.name: Crystalline Power
trophies.description: Terastallize a Pokémon in battle for the first time.
trophies.verification: The Terastallizing animation and crystal-crown effect play on the chosen Pokémon.

trophies.name: Lead the Way
trophies.description: Use Let's Go auto-battle to defeat a wild Pokémon for the first time.
trophies.verification: The lead Pokémon's Let's Go auto-battle animation resolves in a win against a wild Pokémon.

trophies.name: Homemade Technical
trophies.description: Craft a TM at a TM Machine for the first time.
trophies.verification: The crafted TM appears in the Bag's TM pocket.

trophies.name: Picnic Debut
trophies.description: Make your first sandwich at a picnic.
trophies.verification: The sandwich-eating cutscene plays and its Meal Power effects are shown active on screen.

trophies.name: First Badge
trophies.description: Defeat your first Gym Leader and earn a Gym Badge.
trophies.verification: The Gym Leader's defeat cutscene plays and the Badge is added to the Badge case.

trophies.name: Ground Shaker
trophies.description: Defeat your first Titan Pokémon.
trophies.verification: The Titan's defeat cutscene plays and its Herba Mystica is added to the Bag.

trophies.name: Star Struck
trophies.description: Clear your first Team Star base.
trophies.verification: The base leader's defeat cutscene plays and a Star Badge is added to the Badge case.

trophies.name: A Glimmer of Luck
trophies.description: Catch a Shiny Pokémon.
trophies.verification: The Shiny Pokémon is added to the party or box with its distinct color and sparkle animation.

trophies.name: Echo of the Past
trophies.description: Catch an Ancient Paradox Pokémon in Area Zero.
trophies.verification: The caught Paradox Pokémon's entry registers as owned in the Pokédex app.

trophies.name: Tera Raider
trophies.description: Clear a Tera Raid Battle.
trophies.verification: The raid's victory screen plays and its rewards are added to the Bag.

trophies.name: Full Speed Ahead
trophies.description: Unlock Koraidon's Sprinting Build.
trophies.verification: Koraidon's model changes to its Sprinting Build and new traversal options become available.

trophies.name: The Great Crater
trophies.description: Visit Area Zero for the first time.
trophies.verification: The Area Zero region loads and appears on the map for the first time.

trophies.name: Champion's Circuit
trophies.description: Earn all 8 Gym Badges.
trophies.verification: The Badge case screen shows all 8 Gym Badges present.

trophies.name: Legends Uncovered
trophies.description: Defeat all 5 Titan Pokémon and collect enough Herba Mystica for Arven's request.
trophies.verification: The Bag's Herba Mystica tally shows enough ingredients collected, and the path's map markers all show cleared.

trophies.name: Constellation Cleared
trophies.description: Clear all 5 Team Star bases.
trophies.verification: The Badge case screen shows all 5 Star Badges present.

trophies.name: True Form
trophies.description: Unlock Koraidon's Apex Build.
trophies.verification: Koraidon's model changes to its full battle-ready Apex Build, matching its box-art appearance.

trophies.name: Five-Star Challenger
trophies.description: Clear a 5-star Tera Raid Battle.
trophies.verification: The 5-star raid's victory screen plays and its rewards are added to the Bag.

trophies.name: Master Chef
trophies.description: Craft a Master-tier sandwich recipe using Herba Mystica ingredients.
trophies.verification: The Master-tier recipe's completion screen confirms the recipe was made using its required Herba Mystica.

trophies.name: Academy Ace
trophies.description: Win the Academy Ace Tournament for the first time.
trophies.verification: The tournament's victory ceremony plays and the Paldea Champion Ribbon is added to the party.

trophies.name: Six-Star Challenger
trophies.description: Clear a 6-star Tera Raid Battle.
trophies.verification: The 6-star raid's victory screen plays and its rewards are added to the Bag.

trophies.name: Top Champion
trophies.description: Defeat Geeta and become Paldea's Champion.
trophies.verification: Geeta's defeat triggers the Champion title ceremony.

trophies.name: A Cure for Mabosstiff
trophies.description: Defeat Arven in the Path of Legends' climactic battle.
trophies.verification: Arven's defeat triggers the Path of Legends completion cutscene.

trophies.name: Behind the Mask
trophies.description: Defeat Penny in her true identity as Team Star's leader, revealed at the end of Starfall Street.
trophies.verification: Penny's defeat triggers the Starfall Street completion cutscene and Team Star's disbanding.

trophies.name: Pokémon Professor
trophies.description: Complete the base game's Paldea Pokédex, before installing any DLC.
trophies.verification: The Shiny Charm is granted by Jacq, confirming every non-Mythical base-game Pokédex entry has been registered as caught.
trophies.notes: The Paldea Pokédex expands to include Teal Mask/Indigo Disk species once that DLC is installed, which would pull paid DLC content into a base-game trophy's requirements (Rule 14) if pursued out of order. Complete this trophy — and claim the Shiny Charm — before installing either DLC pack; the Charm persists afterward even as the Pokédex grows. Separately, the Pokédex includes Miraidon's slot, Violet's exclusive legendary — completing the dex requires trading for one from another player's Violet copy (or a second personal copy), the same category of external dependency this list already excludes Palafin's Union Circle evolution for under Rule 13. This is standard, unavoidable series behavior rather than a design flaw, but the player should know going in rather than discover it at the very last entry.

trophies.name: Children of Time
trophies.description: Catch every Ancient Paradox Pokémon exclusive to Scarlet: Great Tusk, Scream Tail, Brute Bonnet, Flutter Mane, Slither Wing, Sandy Shocks, and Roaring Moon.
trophies.verification: All seven species show as registered/owned in the Pokédex app.

trophies.name: The Way Home
trophies.description: Descend into Zero Lab, defeat the AI, and confront the hostile wild Koraidon to bring the main story to its end.
trophies.verification: The final battle's defeat triggers the ending sequence and credits.

trophies.name: Paldea's Finest
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.
trophies.verification: All other trophies earned.

trophies.name: Field Trip
trophies.description: Arrive in Kitakami for the school trip.
trophies.verification: The Kitakami region loads for the first time following the school trip cutscene.

trophies.name: Ogre Oustin'
trophies.description: Play the "Ogre Oustin'" minigame for the first time.
trophies.verification: An Ogre Oustin' match concludes and its result screen appears.

trophies.name: Through the Lens
trophies.description: Complete one of Perrin's Timeless Woods photography requests.
trophies.verification: Perrin accepts the submitted photo and the request is marked complete.

trophies.name: Loyal to a Fault: Okidogi
trophies.description: Defeat Okidogi, one of the Loyal Three.
trophies.verification: Okidogi's defeat triggers its mission's clear cutscene.

trophies.name: Loyal to a Fault: Munkidori
trophies.description: Defeat Munkidori, one of the Loyal Three.
trophies.verification: Munkidori's defeat triggers its mission's clear cutscene.

trophies.name: Loyal to a Fault: Fezandipiti
trophies.description: Defeat Fezandipiti, one of the Loyal Three.
trophies.verification: Fezandipiti's defeat triggers its mission's clear cutscene.

trophies.name: Mask of the Forest
trophies.description: Defeat Kieran in the Teal Mask's final battle.
trophies.verification: Kieran's defeat triggers the Teal Mask's ending cutscene.

trophies.name: The Verdant Guardian
trophies.description: Catch Ogerpon.
trophies.verification: Ogerpon is added to the party or box following its capture.

trophies.name: Exchange Student
trophies.description: Arrive at Blueberry Academy in the Terarium as an exchange student.
trophies.verification: The Terarium region loads for the first time following the exchange-student cutscene.

trophies.name: Printed Fresh
trophies.description: Use the Item Printer to craft an item from TM Materials for the first time.
trophies.verification: The printed item appears in the Bag.

trophies.name: Extra Credit
trophies.description: Complete your first Blueberry Quest.
trophies.verification: The Blueberry Quest is marked complete and Blueberry Points are awarded.

trophies.name: Elite Trial: Lacey
trophies.description: Defeat Elite Trial member Lacey.
trophies.verification: Lacey's defeat plays her unique post-battle dialogue and clear cutscene.

trophies.name: Elite Trial: Crispin
trophies.description: Defeat Elite Trial member Crispin.
trophies.verification: Crispin's defeat plays his unique post-battle dialogue and clear cutscene.

trophies.name: Elite Trial: Amarys
trophies.description: Defeat Elite Trial member Amarys.
trophies.verification: Amarys's defeat plays her unique post-battle dialogue and clear cutscene.

trophies.name: Elite Trial: Drayton
trophies.description: Defeat Elite Trial member Drayton.
trophies.verification: Drayton's defeat plays his unique post-battle dialogue and clear cutscene.

trophies.name: BB League Champion
trophies.description: Defeat Kieran as the BB League Champion.
trophies.verification: Kieran's defeat triggers the BB League championship ceremony.

trophies.name: Beyond the Underdepths
trophies.description: Catch Terapagos in the Area Zero Underdepths.
trophies.verification: Terapagos is added to the party or box following its capture.
